title: Chapter 273: See The Golden Equipment Blueprint Again
content:
Chapter 273: See The Golden Equipment Blueprint Again

Wang Shuo touched his nose and said immediately: "Is it okay?"

"Of course, they would like to have more people, the better!"

Also accompanying them were Ye Tianba and Bu Lanlan.

Ye Tianba, like Wang Shuo, was promoted to the town through war and wresting the heart of the town.

Bu Lanlan is the only female mayor among all the mayors.

The four of them walked together.

At this time, Ye Tianba approached Wang Shuo. He grinned and said: "Mayor Wang, we both have the same roots. Why don't we form an alliance? In the subsequent confrontation between the undead, if anyone feels unable to support each other, we can rescue each other. What do you think?"

Wang Shuo saw that the other party offered to form an alliance, but he did not refuse.

In case when the time comes, he really can't stand it anymore, at least he has a thought. Wang Shuo has no expectations about whether the other party can really send troops. It is better to rely on himself than relying on heaven and earth.

"By the way, how do you plan to use the Heart of Town in your hand?" Ye Tianba asked in a low voice.

Wang Shuo thought for a moment, shook his head and said, "I haven't thought about it yet."

"Brother Tianba, do you have any ideas?"

"I'm going to put it up for auction."

Wang Shuo's eyes widened, could he still play like this? Shouldn't we find a few trustworthy lords and let them establish the town as soon as possible?

After hearing the conversation between the two, Lawrence also came over.

"The intensity of the undead attack is directly proportional to the size of the town. It is not your own territory. The higher the level, the better."

"Just like Changping County, the reason why the county magistrate gave us the heart of the town in advance is not because he hopes that we can rescue him when the time comes."

"In the same way, the capital of Hedong County is facing the greatest pressure this time. If a few counties can defend it, they can then support the capital. Of course, this is also a casual move they made."

"When the time comes, we still don't know who will rescue whom! In short, the village's defensive pressure will be minimal."

Wang Shuo couldn't help but sigh, and he didn't know whether it was a good thing or a bad thing to upgrade the town in advance.

Soon, they arrived at the auction hall.

The hall, which can accommodate 200 people, was already full at this time.

Many lords and mayors had received the news in advance, so they arrived early.

"Do you know what is included in this auction?"

Wang Shuo asked with some confusion.

Lawrence immediately called a staff member to bring the auction list.

Wang Shuo took the list.

The auction process and items to be auctioned are written above.

Various weapons and equipment, legion orders, special props, everything you need!

Wang Shuo immediately started browsing carefully.

Not long after, before Wang Shuo finished reading the list, a host walked up to the high platform.

"Dear lords and mayors, thank you all for coming to participate in the auction jointly organized by our Li Chamber of Commerce and Zhang Chamber of Commerce. You must be a little impatient, so I won't waste any more time and invite you to our first auction. Taste."

At this time, a tall, graceful girl walked onto the high platform carrying a tray.

"The first auction item is a set of blueprints for making golden armor. An adventurer obtained it after nearly dying and killing a golden python. At the same time, several of his companions also died, so he I want to auction this thing to pay for my companion’s pension.”

The host, while holding up the drawings, told the story with great emotion.

For this kind of words, just listen to it and make up a story, who can't, maybe it's a story about gangsters taking advantage of gangsters!
